annotation.title_clean: Commission Recommendation (EU) 2026/510 of 6 March 2026 on revising the European assessment framework for 'safe and sustainable by design' chemicals and materials
annotation.title_en: Commission Recommendation (EU) 2026/510 of 6 March 2026 on revising the European assessment framework for 'safe and sustainable by design' chemicals and materials
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
named_instruments_referenced: EU Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation
annotation.summary_en: Commission Recommendation revising the voluntary EU 'safe and sustainable by design' framework for chemicals and materials. It sets out a tiered, iterative safety, environmental and socioeconomic assessment approach for innovators, Member States and research bodies. It is unrelated to AI or robotics apart from a passing mention of an AI-in-science strategy.
key_provisions_or_claims: Voluntary SSbD framework that creates no new legal obligations
Adds scoping analysis, scenario-based entry points and socioeconomic sustainability assessment
Encourages industry, Member States and research institutions to apply the framework and share FAIR data
Tiered safety assessment from qualitative to quantitative, using hazard criteria and risk characterisation ratios
Commission to provide documentation template and monitor uptake in EU-funded R&I
